title: A name is trimmed and not blank
refuses: An empty or blank name, a missing one and one that is not text.

title: An email address looks like an address
refuses: `not-an-email`, `ada@example`, `@example.org`, one with a space, an empty one, a missing one and one that is not text.

title: An email address is kept trimmed and in lower case
accepts: `  Ada@Example.ORG ` as `ada@example.org`; two spellings differing only in case give the same address.

title: A condition is good or needs repair
refuses: `broken`: a return with it is refused as `invalid_condition`, and the schema refuses it written directly.

title: A note is trimmed and not blank
refuses: An empty or blank note, a missing one and one that is not text.
